author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be Roblox being finally investigated by the Federal Government over how much it's put the most vulnerable in danger. Roblox is going to have to hand over paperwork dating quite a while back and be assessed if it did enough over the years, all while losing more players month over month. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: It's Finally Over For Roblox...
